scope: Ten narrow starter questions, not complete coverage of all AI research.

safety.main: (all:"prompt injection") AND (all:agent OR all:tool OR all:defense OR all:defence OR all:security)
safety.evaluation: (all:"prompt injection") AND (all:adaptive OR all:benchmark OR all:evaluation OR all:limitation)

interpretability.main: (all:"sparse autoencoder" OR all:"sparse autoencoders") AND (all:"language model" OR all:interpretability)
interpretability.evaluation: (all:"sparse autoencoder" OR all:"sparse autoencoders") AND (all:faithfulness OR all:causal OR all:benchmark OR all:reliability OR all:limitation OR all:random)

efficiency.main: (all:"speculative decoding" OR all:"speculative sampling") AND (all:"language model" OR all:LLM)
efficiency.evaluation: (all:"speculative decoding") AND (all:serving OR all:latency OR all:throughput OR all:energy OR all:batch)

language.main: (all:"long context" OR all:"long-context") AND (all:reasoning OR all:evaluation OR all:benchmark) AND (all:"language model" OR all:LLM)
language.evaluation: (all:"long context" OR all:"long-context") AND (all:position OR all:failure OR all:reliability OR all:"lost in the middle" OR all:retrieval) AND (all:reasoning OR all:benchmark)

agents.main: (all:"language model" OR all:LLM) AND (all:agent OR all:agents) AND (all:memory OR all:"long horizon" OR all:"long-horizon")
agents.evaluation: (all:"language model" OR all:LLM) AND (all:agent OR all:agents) AND all:memory AND (all:evaluation OR all:benchmark OR all:forgetting OR all:retrieval)

vision.main: all:video AND all:temporal AND (all:reasoning OR all:grounding) AND (all:"language model" OR all:multimodal OR all:"vision-language")
vision.evaluation: all:video AND all:temporal AND (all:benchmark OR all:evaluation OR all:bias) AND (all:reasoning OR all:grounding)

robotics.main: (all:"vision-language-action" OR all:"vision language action" OR all:VLA) AND (all:robot OR all:robotic OR all:robotics) AND (all:embodiment OR all:generalization OR all:transfer)
robotics.evaluation: (all:robot OR all:robotic) AND (all:"cross-embodiment" OR all:"cross embodiment") AND (all:evaluation OR all:benchmark OR all:generalization OR all:transfer)

reinforcement-learning.main: (all:"reward hacking" OR all:"reward overoptimization" OR all:"reward model overoptimization" OR all:"reward gaming") AND (all:"language model" OR all:RLHF OR all:"reward model")
reinforcement-learning.evaluation: (all:"reward model" OR all:RLHF) AND (all:generalization OR all:overoptimization OR all:"reward hacking") AND (all:evaluation OR all:benchmark OR all:scaling)

evaluation.main: (all:"LLM-as-a-judge" OR all:"LLM as a judge" OR all:"language models as evaluators" OR all:"language model judges")
evaluation.evaluation: (all:"LLM-as-a-judge" OR all:"LLM as a judge" OR all:"language model judges") AND (all:bias OR all:reliability OR all:validity OR all:agreement OR all:human)

ai-for-science.main: (all:"neural operator" OR all:"neural operators" OR all:DeepONet) AND (all:generalization OR all:"distribution shift" OR all:extrapolation OR all:"out-of-distribution")
ai-for-science.evaluation: (all:"neural operator" OR all:DeepONet) AND (all:benchmark OR all:evaluation OR all:limitation OR all:robustness) AND (all:PDE OR all:"partial differential" OR all:"operator learning")
